title: NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina Part 8: Purification of Ligation
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Set up deck and reagents
steps.instruction: Review the deck map and liquid legend; allocate TE buffer columns to accommodate up to three sample columns per wash column and ethanol columns to accommodate up to four sample columns per column; if using more than one reagent column, split volumes equally among all columns.

steps.title: Add magnetic beads to samples
steps.instruction: Add the magnetic beads to each sample as indicated in the kit.

steps.title: Incubate bead mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the bead‑sample mixture for the time specified by the kit.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Place the plate on a magnetic stand, allow beads to collect, then carefully remove and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Perform two ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Wash the beads twice with ethanol, removing supernatant after each wash.

steps.title: Air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: Leave the beads on the magnetic stand until all residual ethanol has evaporated, avoiding over‑drying.

steps.title: Elute DNA with TE buffer
steps.instruction: Add TE buffer to the beads, ensuring the TE column can accommodate up to three sample columns per wash column; split the elution volume equally if using multiple columns.

steps.title: Incubate elution
steps.instruction: Incubate the beads with TE buffer for the recommended time to allow DNA release.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to final plate
steps.instruction: Place the plate on the magnetic stand, collect the eluate, and move it to the designated final plate.
